name: Yuri Shubin
intro: I build businesses from scratch and launch new ventures within established companies.

aboutBlocks.lead: I've spent over 20 years building businesses, products, and teams.
aboutBlocks.text: I co-founded an online flight booking service that we launched in nine months.

aboutBlocks.lead: Later, I helped start a new digital products division at a large company.
aboutBlocks.text: I grew the team from 2 to 50 people and led the development of a platform used by tens of thousands of employees.

aboutBlocks.lead: Today, I'm interested in building new businesses with entrepreneurs who know their markets well.
aboutBlocks.text: I can help find and test opportunities, build the product and team, and lead the launch.

aboutBlocks.lead: Let's talk about what we could build together.
